name: Airbus A319
sources: [A319] Airbus AC A319, Rev Jun 01/24 https://www.aircraft.airbus.com/sites/g/files/jlcbta126/files/2025-01/AC_A319_0624.pdf: overall length 33.84 m (p.38); span 34.10 m with wing tip fences (p.37), 35.80 m with sharklets (p.39); nose gear 5.07 m aft of the nose, wheelbase 11.04 m, track 7.59 m (p.37; 11.039 m and 7.590 m, p.331); CFM56 inlet 9.59 m from the nose (p.38); door centre lines from the nose (p.69): door 1L 5.04 m, overwing exits 12.83 m and 13.68 m, door 4L 25.81 m, forward cargo door 8.16 m, aft cargo door 20.56 m, no bulk cargo door; forward hold 3.35 m long, aft and bulk holds 7.67 m (p.65); wing jacking point 15.97 m, safety stay at FR73/FR74 28.83 m (p.131).

[A320] Airbus AC A320, Rev Jun 01/24 https://www.aircraft.airbus.com/sites/g/files/jlcbta126/files/2025-01/AC_A320_0624.pdf: overall length 37.57 m (p.41); span 34.10 m with wing tip fences (p.40), 35.80 m with sharklets (p.42); nose gear 5.07 m aft of the nose, wheelbase 12.64 m, track 7.59 m (p.40; 12.640 m and 7.590 m, p.357); CFM56 inlet 11.19 m from the nose (p.41); door centre lines from the nose (p.74): door 1L 5.04 m, overwing exits 14.43 m and 15.28 m, door 4L 29.53 m, forward cargo door 8.16 m, aft cargo door 22.69 m, bulk cargo door 26.29 m; forward hold 4.95 m long, aft and bulk holds 9.8 m (p.70); wing jacking point 17.56 m, safety stay at FR73/FR74 32.57 m (p.140).

Fuselage, ahead of the wing: 1.60 m shorter. The wheelbase (12.64 to 11.04 m), the overwing exits (14.43 to 12.83 m, 15.28 to 13.68 m), the CFM56 inlet (11.19 to 9.59 m) and the forward hold (4.95 to 3.35 m) each give 1.60 m; the wing jacking point gives 1.59 m. The nose gear (5.07 m), door 1L (5.04 m) and the forward cargo door (8.16 m) do not move: the length comes out between the forward cargo door and the wing.

Fuselage, behind the wing: 2.13 m shorter. The aft and bulk holds give 2.13 m (9.8 to 7.67 m); door 4L moves 3.72 m (29.53 to 25.81 m), the safety stay 3.74 m and the tail 3.73 m (37.57 to 33.84 m), each less the 1.60 m ahead of the wing. The aft cargo door moves 2.13 m (22.69 to 20.56 m): 0.53 m comes out between the wing and that door, 1.60 m between it and door 4L, where the A320 has its bulk cargo door.

foreM + aftM = -3.73 m = 33.84 m - 37.57 m: no rest. The fence sheets' wing tip station (22.40 m on the A320, p.41; 20.86 m on the A319, p.38) gives 1.54 m, 6 cm less than every other pair; the sharklet sheets give 1.60 m (23.45 m, p.43; 21.85 m, p.40).

The same on both aircraft, so the recipe has no wingtip, nacelle, gear or stations. Wing and tail: every dimension of the plan view but the three stations along the fuselage is the same (A319 p.38, A320 p.41), and the wing tip fences and the span are the same. Nacelles: CFM56 2.3 m tall, 2.07 m wide, the same lengths (A319 p.115, A320 p.124). Gear: two wheels on each leg, mains 0.927 m apart and nose wheels 0.500 m apart, tyres 46x17R20 and 30x8.8R15 (A319 p.331, A320 p.357); only the wheelbase differs, by the 1.60 m. Doors: the A320's two passenger doors on each side, moved with the fuselage (29.53 m - 3.73 m = 25.80 m; published 25.81 m).

A19N: the A319neo has the A319's length, doors and gear (33.84 m, p.42; p.69; wheelbase 11.039 m, p.333), with sharklets (span 35.80 m, p.41) and LEAP-1A or PW1100G nacelles (inlet 9.54 m, p.42). This model shows it with the A319's fences and CFM56 nacelles.
